lyrics:
[Intro: dark bouncing bassline, closed hi-hat]

[Verse 1: deadpan half-spoken male voice]
He comes down at nine
White shirt, sits at the end
Says the same two words each time
Bartender's his friend

[Chorus: bass and kick, voice doubled low]
Sparkling, no ice
Sparkling, no ice
Everybody's on their third
He's had one thing, twice
Sparkling, no ice

[Drop: bassline, clap, filtered chord stab]

[Verse 2: deadpan, percussion added]
They laughed at him at ten
They're asleep on chairs by one
He's reading by the deep end
Dry and clear and done

[Chorus: bass and kick, voice doubled low]
Sparkling, no ice
Sparkling, no ice
Everybody's on their third
He's had one thing, twice
Sparkling, no ice

[Break: bass drops out, hi-hat and voice]
He tips well. He remembers your name.
He drives everyone home.

[Final Chorus: full groove, a high synth line]
Sparkling, no ice
Sparkling, no ice
Everybody's on the floor
He's had one thing, twice
Sparkling, no ice

[Outro: bassline alone, a bottle cap, fizz]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, F# minor. Dark, dry and bouncing tech house, hypnotic and a little funny.

VOICE: Male, low and deadpan, half-spoken with a slight melodic lift at the ends of lines, British-sounding, very dry. Doubled an octave lower in the choruses. The break is plainly spoken.

INSTRUMENTS: A dark, bouncing, slightly detuned bass riff, a tight four-on-the-floor kick, a sharp clap, closed and open hi-hats, a filtered minor chord stab, a shaker, a thin high synth line in the last chorus, a bottle cap and fizz.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, bass and hi-hat. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:04 Drop. 1:20 Verse 2. 1:44 Chorus 2. 2:08 Break, hi-hat and voice. 2:24 Final chorus. 2:50 Outro, bass, a cap and fizz, ends 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2017 UK tech house: minimal, dry and punchy, bass and kick tight together, vocal up front with almost no reverb.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'He's had one thing, twice' at 0:52.

STATION FIT: Midnight. The darkest groove in the pack, for the late hour when the station leans toward club records at low volume.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Curious, amused, respectful, quietly on his side.
